title: Vasaloppet Base Endurance - Steady State Cardio

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through full range of motion, coordinate breath with movement. Warm up spine and core.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the transition between sides, maintain upright posture. Prepare hips for endurance work.

items.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
items.cues: Move ankles through full range, increase circulation to lower legs. Essential for endurance activity.

items.name: Air Bike - Easy Pace
items.cues: Light resistance, RPE 2-3. Focus on smooth pedal strokes and settling into rhythm.

items.name: Air Bike - Steady State Endurance
items.cues: Maintain RPE 5-6 throughout. This is conversational intensity - you should be able to speak but not sing. Find a sustainable cadence (90-100 rpm), keep shoulders relaxed, engage core. Focus on steady breathing rhythm. This builds aerobic base essential for 90km Vasaloppet.

items.name: Air Bike - Easy Spin Down
items.cues: Reduce resistance gradually, RPE 2-3. Allow heart rate to settle, focus on deep breathing.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 30 seconds, keep heel on ground. Reduce tightness from cycling motion.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 30 seconds, relax shoulders. Open up upper body after sustained effort.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Slow, controlled movements. Activate stabilizer muscles and promote core recovery.

rationale: User is returning from 999 days without training - starting with moderate intensity endurance base work on Air Bike allows safe cardiovascular rebuilding without impact stress before Vasaloppet in 53 days.
70-minute steady-state session at RPE 5-6 develops aerobic capacity essential for 90km ski race; gym-based cycling provides controlled environment for base phase training with no injury risk.
Extended 50-minute main set builds muscular endurance and aerobic threshold with proper warm-up and cool-down protocols appropriate for intermediate athlete returning to training.
